description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Amendment to the Notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1861/38 of 08.05.2014 under section 46 of Sri Lanka Electricity Act No. 20 of 2009
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of an annual levy on electricity licensees under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for utility providers, falling under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. The content establishes financial obligations for licensees and revokes a previous gazette notification, which are characteristic of regulatory actions under existing legislation.
